notice: All photographs are AI-generated synthetic images of a fictional, unbadged vehicle. They do not depict a real vehicle, person, location, license plate or incident.

generation.method: AI image generation (GitHub Copilot image_generation tool)
generation.consistencyApproach: The first image was generated from text only. Every later image was generated with the first image (and, for the side view, also the rear overview) supplied as a visual reference so the same vehicle, paint, wheels, cladding, damage and parking-lot setting carry across all photographs.
generation.importProcess: build_evidence.py --import-photos converts each source PNG to a baseline JPEG (quality 88, 4:2:0 subsampling) with no EXIF or other embedded metadata. Pixels and dimensions are unchanged.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Right-side profile rendered with the vehicle facing the wrong way, which placed the visible damage at the front of the frame. Regenerated with explicit orientation; this candidate is not used.

generation.manualReview: Each image was inspected visually before import: same deep blue unbadged crossover SUV, black lower cladding and roof rails, silver five-spoke wheels, the same right rear corner collision damage in every view that shows that corner, overcast parking lot, no people, no readable text, blank license plates, no annotations or overlays.

photos.title: Right rear corner, three-quarter view

Subject: a modern mid-size five-door crossover SUV painted deep metallic blue, with black plastic lower body cladding, black roof rails, slim horizontal LED tail lamps that wrap around the rear corners, and silver five-spoke alloy wheels. The vehicle has NO brand badges, NO logos, NO emblems and NO lettering anywhere. View: rear three-quarter view from the vehicle's right rear corner, about 2 meters away, showing the right rear quarter panel, the right side of the rear bumper and the right tail lamp. Damage: fresh collision damage concentrated at the right rear corner - the right side of the rear bumper cover is pushed inward and cracked with scuffed paint, the right rear quarter panel behind the rear wheel has a deep creased dent with scraped paint and grey transfer marks, and the right tail lamp lens is cracked with a few small red plastic fragments on the ground. The rear license plate is a plain blank white plate with no characters. Setting: an outdoor shopping-center parking lot on an overcast day, dry grey asphalt with painted white stall lines, a few distant parked cars out of focus, no people, no readable signs or text anywhere. Natural, slightly flat overcast light, realistic colors, no watermark, no annotations, no arrows, no text overlay.
